metadata.summary: VinDr-CXR is a large chest X-ray dataset of 18,000 posteroanterior (PA) radiographs from 18,000 patients, collected at two hospitals in Vietnam. It provides 22 localized bounding-box annotations for findings plus 6 global (image-level) labels.
metadata.purpose: Used for lesion detection and image-level classification benchmarks.

papers.title: VinDr-CXR: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Chest X-ray Abnormality Detection

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identified; no protected health information retained.
ethics.legal_compliance: Complies with PhysioNet Open Data policy.

known_limitations: Test labels are consensus (limited individual-rater variance)
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: 90%+ Vietnamese, two-center, PA-only — limited generalizability to global or multi-view settings.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Limited generalizability outside Vietnamese adult PA chest X-ray settings.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No explicit reporting on sex, age subgroups, or skin tone; known absence of pediatric, pregnancy, elderly, and critical-care representation.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Tasks requiring lateral views, pediatric imaging, or non-chest pathology.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Collected at two hospitals in Vietnam.

population.missing_groups: Pediatric, pregnancy, elderly, and critical-care populations not explicitly reported; dataset scoped to adult chest findings.

annotation.annotation_method: Training set labeled by 17 radiologists; test set labeled by consensus of senior radiologists.

annotators.qualifications: Radiologists (training set); senior radiologists (test set, consensus)

annotation.labeling_provenance: Bounding-box and global labels derived from expert radiologist annotation.
annotation.label_noise_description: Test set uses consensus labeling, limiting individual-rater variance; training set may contain inter-rater variability.
